$semantics.endingBalance: F7: D15 =D9+N5-D11-S5 on a month tab, =D9+P6-D11-V6 on Weekly: start + income - spent - saved. The month tabs' income and savings are 0 (N5, S5), their rows being dated 2025 (plan section 5.5), so Jan and Feb prove the start less Spent, Feb's below zero. Weekly's window holds the $2,600 pay (P6) and the $2,000 moved to the Emergency Fund (V6), so 515 proves income is added and savings taken off.
$semantics.starts: D9 is typed 1000 on every tab. With none typed the engine gives no ending balance (D17); no cached cell can show that, so it is a hand-written test.
$semantics.planHistory: D13. Workbook's one Monthly Amount serves every tab; each is typed here as a row from 2025-01, the month of Weekly Budget!D6, and every case resolves it from that history, as in workbook-month part 2.
$semantics.signs: D3: spending, savings and logged payments are negated in the ledger; income stays positive.
$semantics.left out: Paycheck Budget!D15 (465): Workbook adds Credit Card 1's $200 to its $50 plan, where D5 replaces the plan (plan section 5.4). Dec!D15 (132.01) repeats Jan's inputs.
$semantics.merchants: The engine takes no merchant text; no Notes column is transcribed. Ids are synthetic.
